About this data#

  • This view tracks the ChatGPT Plugin Directory — OpenAI’s collection of MCP-based integrations — and updates once a day. Right now that’s 17,376 plugins, last updated Fri, 27 Nov 2026 00:00:28 GMT.
  • OpenAI doesn’t publish popularity scores or install counts, so plugins are ranked by where the directory itself places them: each plugin’s best position in any of its categories.
  • We save a snapshot every day so you can see how rankings change over time. We’ve been tracking for 31 days so far. The growth and category charts go further back: they use the date each plugin joined the directory, so they cover its whole history.
  • Developers: the full ranked list for this view is available as JSON at /api/servers/chatgpt.
